card.name: Mid-number pieces and second-item words
card.fires_on: Marked word or symbol in the middle of a number range, decimal, abbreviation or dose phrase, often right before a second part is expected. Examples are a decimal point in a range, 'tablet' after 'the other', or 'ivalent' after 'tr'.

modes.label: Decimal points and digits
modes.description: The decimal point or digit inside a number range in dosing tables or verse references.

modes.label: The other tablet
modes.description: A unit word that completes a pair or second dose in missed-dose or dosing instructions.
modes.example: take one risedronate sodium tablet 75 mg in the morning after the day it is remembered and then the other<< tablet>> on the next consecutive morning.

modes.label: Inside split terms
modes.description: Part of a longer word or abbreviation, such as 'tr-ivalent' or 't.i.d.'.
modes.example: with formulations containing divalent and tr<<ivalent>> cations such as didanosine buffered
